title: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4-Spark on two Sparks
evidence_scope: MTP3 with native prefix caching, a 1,048,576-token context window and 10 GiB of KV cache per Spark in 2,048-token pages, on installer image dev-20260928-plainstatus-cuda1342-nccl2323-status033: an installation through install.sh on one pair passed 7 of 7 functional checks (counting, arithmetic, code, tool calls, image, thinking) and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate response, reported 1,530,566 KV tokens, and decoded 38.0 / 108 / 98 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 2,507 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20260928-plainstatus-glm53-flash-tp2-20260929.md); image, video and text memory loads are in performance/records/glm53-flash/installer-memory-20260929.md; single-run timing; not serving-qualified.
